projects.title: iDropbox
projects.description: Web application built to address Summer storage issue that all out-of-state and international students suffer. CSS, jQuery, and EJS were used for dynamic rendering of available storage lists based on user's input, and Node.js + Express.js used for the server that does basic routing. MongoDB with Mongoose was used as a database.

projects.title: Find Eat
projects.description: Responsive web app for a restaurant suggestion. The user inputs a desired cuisine and ranks price, distance, and rating in order of personal preference. As an output, app returns about 10 stacks of cards with information on suggested restaurants. The user can "Keep" or "Pass" the card until only one is left. In short, the app is Tinder, but for restaurants. HTML & CSS and Bootstrap3 are used for frontend design, and Javascript & Factual API are used for the backend and data retrieval.
